title: Five things we will not do to you
lead: Five promises we make to every nursery that joins Yawmy Care.

charge.title: We never charge parents
charge.body: We will never charge your parents. One flat fee, paid by the nursery. No commission on tuition.

dataYours.title: Your data is yours
dataYours.body: Your data is yours. Export your records whenever you want, without asking us.

arabic.title: Arabic is not a translation
arabic.body: Arabic is not a translation layer. Full RTL, Arabic notifications, Arabic support.

human.title: You can talk to a human
human.body: A human answers, in Arabic, within one working day.

dataStays.title: Your data stays with you
dataStays.body: If you leave, you leave with everything. 90 days to export, then permanent deletion.
